verses.original: ה֚וֹי הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֣ים בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְהַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בְּהַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן נְקֻבֵי֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם לָהֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וּבָ֥אוּ
verses.transliteration: hō·w haš·ša·’ă·nan·nîm bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm bə·har šō·mə·rō·wn nə·qu·ḇê rê·šîṯ hag·gō·w·yim lā·hem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇā·’ū
verses.literal: Woe to those at ease in Zion and those secure on Mount Samaria the distinguished ones of the foremost nation to whom the house of Israel comes

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ כַֽלְנֵה֙ וּרְא֔וּ וּלְכ֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם רַבָּ֑ה חֲמַ֣ת וּרְד֣וּ גַת־ פְּלִשְׁתּ֗ים הֲטוֹבִים֙ מִן־ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אִם־ הַמַּמְלָכ֣וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖ם רַ֥ב מִגְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iḇ·rū ḵal·nêh ū·rə·’ū ū·lə·ḵū miš·šām rab·bāh ḥă·maṯ ū·rə·ḏū ḡaṯ- pə·liš·tm hă·ṭō·w·ḇîm min- hā·’êl·leh ’im- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ gə·ḇū·lām raḇ mig·gə·ḇul·ḵem
verses.literal: Cross over to Calneh and see go from there to the great Hamath then go down to Gath of the Philistines Are you better than these . . . kingdoms Is their territory larger than yours

verses.original: הַֽמְנַדִּ֖ים לְי֣וֹם רָ֑ע וַתַּגִּישׁ֖וּן שֶׁ֥בֶת חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ham·nad·dîm lə·yō·wm rā‘ wat·tag·gî·šūn še·ḇeṯ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence

verses.original: הַשֹּֽׁכְבִים֙ עַל־ מִטּ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔ן וּסְרֻחִ֖ים עַל־ עַרְשׂוֹתָ֑ם וְאֹכְלִ֤ים כָּרִים֙ מִצֹּ֔אן וַעֲגָלִ֖ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ מַרְבֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘al- miṭ·ṭō·wṯ šên ū·sə·ru·ḥîm ‘al- ‘ar·śō·w·ṯām wə·’ō·ḵə·lîm kā·rîm miṣ·ṣōn wa·‘ă·ḡā·lîm mit·tō·wḵ mar·bêq
verses.literal: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory and lounge upon your couches You dine on lambs from the flock and calves from the stall

verses.original: הַפֹּרְטִ֖ים עַל־ פִּ֣י הַנָּ֑בֶל כְּדָוִ֕יד חָשְׁב֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם שִֽׁיר׃ כְּלֵי־
verses.transliteration: hap·pō·rə·ṭîm ‘al- pî han·nā·ḇel kə·ḏā·wîḏ ḥā·šə·ḇū lā·hem šîr kə·lê-
verses.literal: You improvise songs vvv on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments

verses.original: הַשֹּׁתִ֤ים יַ֔יִן בְּמִזְרְקֵי֙ יִמְשָׁ֑חוּ וְרֵאשִׁ֥ית שְׁמָנִ֖ים וְלֹ֥א נֶחְל֖וּ עַל־ שֵׁ֥בֶר יוֹסֵֽף
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·ṯîm ya·yin bə·miz·rə·qê yim·šā·ḥū wə·rê·šîṯ šə·mā·nîm wə·lō neḥ·lū ‘al- šê·ḇer yō·sēp̄
verses.literal: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן עַתָּ֥ה יִגְל֖וּ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ גֹּלִ֑ים מִרְזַ֥ח סְרוּחִֽים׃פ וְסָ֖ר
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘at·tāh yiḡ·lū bə·rōš gō·lîm mir·zaḥ sə·rū·ḥîm wə·sār
verses.literal: Therefore you will now go into exile as the first of the captives and your feasting and lounging will come to an end

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה נִשְׁבַּע֩ בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת נְאֻם־ אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶת־ מְתָאֵ֤ב יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב גְּא֣וֹן שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְאַרְמְנֹתָ֖יו וְהִסְגַּרְתִּ֖י עִ֥יר וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh niš·ba‘ bə·nap̄·šōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ nə·’um- ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eṯ- mə·ṯā·’êḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ gə·’ō·wn śā·nê·ṯî wə·’ar·mə·nō·ṯāw wə·his·gar·tî ‘îr ū·mə·lō·’āh
verses.literal: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself the LORD the God of Hosts has declared I - abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels so I will deliver up the city and everything in it

verses.original: אִם־ וְהָיָ֗ה עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים יִוָּ֨תְר֜וּ אֶחָ֖ד בְּבַ֥יִת וָמֵֽתוּ׃
verses.literal: And if there are ten men left in one house they too will die

verses.original: דּוֹד֣וֹ וּמְסָרְפ֗וֹ וּנְשָׂא֞וֹ עֲצָמִים֮ לְהוֹצִ֣יא מִן־ הַבַּיִת֒ וְאָמַ֞ר לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת הַע֥וֹד עִמָּ֖ךְ אָ֑פֶס וְאָמַ֣ר הָ֔ס וְאָמַ֣ר כִּ֛י בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃ לֹ֥א לְהַזְכִּ֖יר
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏōw ū·mə·sā·rə·p̄ōw ū·nə·śā·’ōw ‘ă·ṣā·mîm lə·hō·w·ṣî min- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·’ā·mar la·’ă·šer bə·yar·kə·ṯê hab·ba·yiṯ ha·‘ō·wḏ ‘im·māḵ ’ā·p̄es wə·’ā·mar hās wə·’ā·mar kî bə·šêm Yah·weh lō lə·haz·kîr
verses.literal: And when the relative who is to burn [the bodies] picks them up . . . to remove them from the house he will call to one inside - Is anyone else with you None that person will answer Silence [the relative] will retort for the name of the LORD must not be invoked

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל הַבַּ֥יִת וְהִכָּ֛ה רְסִיסִ֑ים הַקָּטֹ֖ן וְהַבַּ֥יִת בְּקִעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh Yah·weh mə·ṣaw·weh hag·gā·ḏō·wl hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hik·kāh rə·sî·sîm haq·qā·ṭōn wə·hab·ba·yiṯ bə·qi·‘îm
verses.literal: For . . . the LORD gives a command The great house will be smashed to pieces and the small house to rubble

verses.original: סוּסִ֔ים אִֽם־ הַיְרֻצ֤וּן בַּסֶּ֙לַע֙ יַחֲר֖וֹשׁ בַּבְּקָרִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הֲפַכְתֶּ֤ם מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לְרֹאשׁ֙ וּפְרִ֥י צְדָקָ֖ה לְלַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: sū·sîm ’im- hay·ru·ṣūn bas·se·la‘ ya·ḥă·rō·wōš bab·bə·qā·rîm kî- hă·p̄aḵ·tem miš·pāṭ lə·rōš ū·p̄ə·rî ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·la·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Do horses . . . gallop on the cliffs Does one plow [the sea] with oxen But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֖ים לְלֹ֣א דָבָ֑ר הָאֹ֣מְרִ֔ים הֲל֣וֹא לָקַ֥חְנוּ קַרְנָֽיִם׃ לָ֖נוּ בְחָזְקֵ֔נוּ
verses.transliteration: haś·śə·mê·ḥîm lə·lō ḏā·ḇār hā·’ō·mə·rîm hă·lō·w lā·qaḥ·nū qar·nā·yim lā·nū ḇə·ḥā·zə·qê·nū
verses.literal: you who rejoice vvv in Lo-debar and say Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנְנִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים גּ֑וֹי עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת וְלָחֲצ֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־ נַ֥חַל הָעֲרָבָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî mê·qîm gō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·lā·ḥă·ṣū ’eṯ·ḵem mil·lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ ‘aḏ- na·ḥal hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: For behold I will raise up a nation against you O house of Israel declares the LORD the God of Hosts and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath . . . to the Brook of the Arabah
